svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 05/12 The Greek Theatre (Uncommon)
svg.desc: An open-air amphitheater in the eucalyptus. The stone seats stay warm after dark. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
